author: fwyzard
body:
#### PR description:

The streamer output modules accept `compression_algorithm` "LZ4", with `compression_level` 1-3 for the fast LZ4 compressor and 4-12 for LZ4 HC (ROOT uses the same split and stops at 9).

Compressed events start with the `L4` header, and the input sources and `DiagStreamerFile` detect and decompress them like the other algorithms.

The output tests take a compression level; NewStreamerLZ4 and NewStreamerLZ4HC run the round trip at levels 1 and 9.

#### PR validation:

Unit tests pass.

Streamer files in Lz4 format were read back and used to run an HLT job.
title: Add LZ4 compression to the streamer format
